conventions.readingOrder: 왼쪽에서 오른쪽으로 읽고, 다음 줄로 내려갑니다
conventions.rootMotion: 제자리 모션. 화면의 이동과 점프 높이는 게임 코드에서 적용
conventions.sheetLayout: 동작별 고정 4열. 프레임 수는 각 동작에 기록.
conventions.renderScale: 모든 재생 자세는 같은 배율과 발 기준점으로 표시.
conventions.weapon: 런타임 몸 레이어 → 고정 검 → 손 레이어. HD는 조립된 시트.

clips.label: 숨쉬며 대기
clips.motion: Planted feet with a small breathing cycle: head, torso, sword arm, hips and knees move gently while both soles stay at the same floor line; return to the starting pose.

clips.label: 걷기
clips.motion: in-place complete walk cycle: right heel contact, right foot down, legs passing, right leg trailing, left heel contact, left foot down, legs passing, left leg trailing; relaxed sword held low and no root travel

clips.label: 달리기
clips.motion: in-place complete run cycle: right forward contact, compress, passing legs, suspended stride, left forward contact, compress, passing legs, suspended stride; body leans forward, scarf follows

clips.label: 대기에서 걷기
clips.motion: bridge neutral idle to walk: neutral low sword ready stance, weight shifts rear foot, heel lifts, front knee bends, front foot begins reach, torso leans slightly, heel approaches floor, end exactly right heel contact walk pose

clips.label: 걷기에서 달리기
clips.motion: accelerate walking into running in place: walk contact, shorten body, lean forward, bend elbows, push off, increase stride, scarf rises left, end right forward contact run pose

clips.label: 달리기에서 걷기
clips.motion: decelerate run into walk in place: run contact leaning forward, torso lifts, shorten stride, elbows lower, scarf settles, reduce knee height, upright step, end right heel contact walk pose

clips.label: 달리다 멈추기
clips.motion: run braking transition in place: running contact, front foot plants, lean backward braking, knees compress, trailing foot catches up, torso straightens, scarf swings forward then settles, end canonical neutral sword-low idle

clips.label: 걷기에서 대기
clips.motion: bridge walk to idle: right heel contact walking pose, plant foot, trailing foot comes forward, shorten stride, torso straightens, both feet shoulder width, scarf settles, end canonical neutral low sword idle pose

clips.label: 점프 준비와 이륙
clips.motion: jump anticipation and takeoff without root travel: neutral, knees soften, squat deeper, swing empty arm back, explosive leg extension, heel rises, toes leave baseline, knees begin tuck into first jump rise pose

clips.label: 점프 상승
clips.motion: already airborne rising poses, body root remains in fixed cell, knees bend backwards then lift toward torso, scarf and cloak hang downward from upward motion, sword held close, transition to tucked apex pose

clips.label: 점프 최고점
clips.motion: airborne jump apex, knees tucked, torso slightly untucks, scarf briefly floats upward, eight distinct small easing poses ending with feet beginning to extend for fall; root remains fixed

clips.label: 낙하
clips.motion: airborne falling loop, legs extended slightly bent ready to land, cloak and scarf lifted above shoulders, controlled small flutter, fixed root, no ground or movement across cell

clips.label: 가벼운 착지
clips.motion: soft jump landing: airborne falling feet extended, toes touch baseline, knees absorb landing, moderate crouch, cloak settles down, hips rise, torso straightens, end canonical neutral low sword idle

clips.label: 높은 곳에서 착지
clips.motion: heavy fall landing: feet about to touch ground, feet contact, knees bend deeply, one free hand touches floor, cloak drops, hand lifts, hips rise, end canonical neutral low sword idle

clips.label: 가벼운 착지
clips.motion: soft jump landing: airborne falling feet extended, toes touch baseline, knees absorb landing, moderate crouch, cloak settles down, hips rise, torso straightens, end canonical neutral low sword idle

clips.label: 지상 대시 시작
clips.motion: dash anticipation from neutral: weight forward, front knee bends, torso lowers, rear foot pushes, sword moves behind, body leans almost horizontal, scarf whips left, end canonical low ground dash pose

clips.label: 지상 대시
clips.motion: fast low grounded dash held loop, body nearly horizontal leaning right, bent leading knee, trailing leg extended, sword tightly behind and scarf streams left, small alternating leg motions without root travel

clips.label: 지상 대시 종료
clips.motion: ground dash braking: low dash, leading foot plants, knee absorbs, torso begins rise, trailing foot catches up, sword lowers to side, cloak settles, end canonical neutral low sword idle

clips.label: 공중 대시
clips.motion: airborne forward dash: tighten core, lean horizontally right, extend trailing legs, stable fast flying pose, scarf snaps left, head lifts, legs tuck, end with airborne bent-knee pose; root fixed

clips.label: 공중 대시에서 낙하
clips.motion: air dash to fall transition with fixed root: start horizontal airborne dash, chest lifts, feet drop under hips, scarf floats up, torso upright, knees slightly bent, sword close, end canonical falling ready pose

clips.label: 기본 베기 1타
clips.motion: one complete horizontal sword slash: neutral low sword, draw sword back left, coil torso, sword crosses front right, full rightward horizontal extension, torso follows, decelerate, finish sword extended low right; no magical slash trail

clips.label: 연속 베기 2타
clips.motion: one rising diagonal sword slash: start with sword chambered low left, knees bent, unwind torso, sword rises across chest, blade crosses above head, extend arm upward right, settle hips, end sword raised above right shoulder

clips.label: 연속 베기 3타
clips.motion: strong downward finishing slash: begin sword above head, elbow coils, lift on toes, shoulders drive down, sword cuts diagonally down right, knee compresses, blade decelerates near low right, finish deep forward follow-through

clips.label: 1타에서 2타 연결
clips.motion: attack combo bridge: start first horizontal slash end blade low right, elbow retracts, blade circles down along side, weight shifts rear, knees bend, blade chambers low left, torso coils, end exact rising-slash windup blade low left

clips.label: 2타에서 3타 연결
clips.motion: attack combo bridge: start rising slash ending sword above right shoulder, wrist pivots, left hand joins grip, sword rotates overhead, hips turn, lift on toes, shoulders coil, end exact third slash overhead windup

clips.label: 1타 후 자세 회복
clips.motion: horizontal slash recovery: start sword extended low right, elbow softens, hips untwist, sword lowers, rear foot settles, torso upright, scarf returns, end canonical neutral low sword idle

clips.label: 2타 후 자세 회복
clips.motion: rising slash recovery: start blade high above right shoulder, elbow bends, blade rotates down forward, shoulders uncoil, sword lowers at side, hips center, scarf settles, end canonical neutral low sword idle

clips.label: 3타 후 자세 회복
clips.motion: downward finisher recovery: start deep forward follow-through blade low right, knees absorb, elbow loosens, blade lifts slightly clear of floor, hips rise, torso straightens, feet center, end canonical neutral low sword idle

clips.label: 강공격 힘 모으기
clips.motion: heavy sword attack windup only: neutral, two hands grip hilt, sword pulled back, weight shifts rear foot, knees bend, sword rises above head, torso coils, hold deep overhead charged stance; no energy effect

clips.label: 강공격 내려베기
clips.motion: heavy overhead release from charged stance: sword overhead, weight forward, hips rotate, blade accelerating down, strong impact pose low right, deep knee compression, sword settles low right, hold deep heavy follow-through; no explosion

clips.label: 강공격 후 자세 회복
clips.motion: heavy attack recovery: start deep two-handed low sword follow-through, pause compressed, loosen shoulders, sword lifts clear of floor, hips rise slowly, left hand releases, torso upright, end canonical neutral low sword idle

clips.label: 찌르기
clips.motion: sword thrust: neutral low guard, raise blade horizontally chest height, retract elbow, lean forward, fully extend right arm and sword right, front knee compresses, slight retract, end blade horizontal forward at chest height

clips.label: 찌르기 후 자세 회복
clips.motion: thrust recovery: sword extended horizontally right at chest height, elbow retracts straight back, front knee relaxes, blade tilts downward, torso recenters, grip lowers, scarf settles, end canonical neutral low sword idle

clips.label: 대시 베기
clips.motion: dashing slash in place: low dash pose sword trailing, shoulders coil, sword accelerates across front, blade extends right horizontally, low lunge, scarf follows, braking knee bends, end low sword-forward lunge; no afterimage

clips.label: 대시 공격 후 회복
clips.motion: dash slash recovery: start low sword-forward lunge, leading foot brakes, rear leg catches up, sword lowers, torso rises, shoulders uncoil, cloak settles, end canonical neutral low sword idle

clips.label: 공중 베기
clips.motion: airborne sword slash with no ground: tucked jump pose, sword draws back, torso rotates, slash forward right, blade extended diagonally, knees extend down, sword settles down right, end falling ready pose

clips.label: 공중 공격 후 착지
clips.motion: air attack landing: start falling with sword down right, extend feet, toes contact floor, knees bend and free hand balances, blade held low away from feet, rise from crouch, shoulders square, end canonical neutral low sword idle

clips.label: 웅크려 베기
clips.motion: low crouching sword slash: crouched guard, draw sword to side, twist hips while low, sweep blade at shin height right, extend blade, keep knees bent, decelerate sword, end low crouched forward sword extension

clips.label: 앉은 공격 후 회복
clips.motion: crouching slash recovery without standing: start low forward sword extension, elbow retracts, shoulders untwist, knees stay deeply bent, sword lowers close to front knee, torso centers, scarf settles, end canonical crouch guard pose

clips.label: 웅크리기 시작
clips.motion: neutral idle to crouch: sword low, knees start bend, hips lower, torso tilts forward, head lowers, rear knee folds, sword moves low forward, end canonical low crouched guard

clips.label: 웅크리기 해제
clips.motion: low crouch to idle: crouched guard, weight centered, front knee extends, hips rise, torso unfolds, head rises, cloak settles, end canonical neutral low sword idle

clips.label: 웅크려 대기
clips.motion: low crouched guard breathing loop, both feet planted, knees deeply bent, torso forward, sword low forward, soft inhale then exhale and return exactly to first crouched pose

clips.label: 웅크려 걷기
clips.motion: complete stealth crouch walk cycle in place, stay low: front foot reaches, planted front foot, back foot slides forward, legs pass, opposite foot reaches, planted, back slides, legs pass

clips.label: 방어 시작
clips.motion: idle to guarding: neutral sword low, raise sword grip, left hand reaches hilt, sword rotates vertical in front, knees soften, shoulders brace, chin tucks, end canonical sword guard pose

clips.label: 방어 유지
clips.motion: steady sword guard breathing loop: sword vertical diagonal in front of face and chest, right hand near waist with left supporting grip, knees soft, inhale and exhale, minimal shield-like protective posture; no shield object

clips.label: 방어 해제
clips.motion: guard to idle: sword vertical guard, shoulders relax, left hand releases grip, sword tilts down, elbows lower, knees straighten, cloak settles, end canonical neutral low sword idle

clips.label: 방어 중 충격 흡수
clips.motion: block impact and regain guard: canonical sword guard, grip braces, torso pushes backward a little, knees compress, blade wobbles slightly, body pushes forward, knees recover, return exactly to canonical sword guard; no sparks

clips.label: 방어가 깨짐
clips.motion: guard break stagger: sword guard, arms pushed open, sword tilts outward, chest opens, torso recoils, rear knee bends, sword falls low, end backward stagger matching hurt end; no broken blade

clips.label: 마법 준비
clips.motion: magic charge body motion only: neutral sword low in right hand, lift empty left hand, open palm right, shoulders pull back, knees brace, palm draws close to chest, look forward, hold prepared casting stance; absolutely no glow or magic effects

clips.label: 마법 발사
clips.motion: magic release body motion only: start empty left palm near chest, elbow draws back, palm pushes right, full arm extension right, small torso recoil, left hand remains forward, shoulder relaxes, finish palm extended forward; sword held low in right hand, no projectile

clips.label: 마법 후 자세 회복
clips.motion: magic release recovery: start left palm fully extended right and right sword low, relax fingers, bend left elbow, lower hand, center shoulders, straighten knees, cloak settles, end canonical neutral low sword idle

clips.label: 가벼운 피격
clips.motion: non-graphic light hit reaction: neutral, shoulders jolt backward, head leans back, front knee buckles, cloak follows, torso recoils, head returns forward, finish slight backward stagger with sword low; no blood or flashes

clips.label: 피격 후 회복
clips.motion: recover stagger to idle: start leaning backward hurt pose, brace rear foot, head forward, chest centers, hips center, knees straighten, sword held low, end canonical neutral low sword idle

clips.label: 넘어짐
clips.motion: non-graphic knockdown: off balance standing, lean backward, knees buckle, hips drop, elbow reaches ground, torso rolls onto side, legs fold, finish lying on side on ground with sword beside hand; face still points right

clips.label: 쓰러져 패배
clips.motion: non-graphic defeat animation: neutral exhausted, knees soften, shoulders slump, drop to one knee, head lowers, elbow reaches floor, torso slumps onto side, lie still with sword beside hand; no blood no disintegration

clips.label: 넘어진 뒤 일어나기
clips.motion: get up from knockdown: lying on right-facing side holding sword, free hand supports floor, torso lifts, one knee plants, kneel upright, push through front foot, rise almost standing, end canonical neutral low sword idle
